g.text: Available to Router / Agent DO / Outbound Handler
class MySandbox extends Sandbox (→ Container → DurableObject)
Per-task ephemeral VM. Addressed by task ID. Disposed when task completes.
• Your devcontainer + OpenCode • Postgres, Redis, queues, app, browser
• No SDKs, no credentials inside the VM. Egress is plain fetch().
Static method on Sandbox class. Runs in trusted Workers runtime. Intercepts every fetch() leaving the VM.
'my.kv' : (req, env) => env.KV.get(...) → binding lookup, no network
'my.db' : (req, env) => env.PRIVATE_DB.fetch(req) → Workers VPC Service → Tunnel
'mcp.acme.com' : (req, env) => attach Access service token, route to MCP Server Portal
